title: Apexspace bus card
description: A black, hairline-outlined product card with small + crosshairs at its corners: a wide uppercase name and a row of orbit tags (solid border = standard, dashed = option, dim dashed = not offered), a 16:9 media frame in a tall empty field, two spec rows split by hairlines (mono label + icon left, big light figure with a unit and a grey note right), and a full-width bar in the product's tone whose text lightens on hover.
notes: tone picks the product colour from chart-1 … chart-4 (tag borders and the bottom bar)
media is a 16:9 clip shown like object-fit: contain; empty shows a muted placeholder frame
the corner crosshairs sit 5px outside the card: leave a little room around it
name: apexspace-bus-card

props.name: name
props.description: the product name, set wide and uppercase

props.name: tone
props.description: which product colour it uses (chart-1 … chart-4)

props.name: tags
props.description: the orbit or size tags beside the name

props.name: media
props.description: the 16:9 product clip (shown like object-fit: contain); empty shows a placeholder

props.name: stats
props.description: the spec rows (two in the original)

props.name: cta
props.description: the full-width bar at the bottom
